title: Potted individuals · dated research figure
credit: Crispim Massuela et al. (2022), Figure 1 · CC BY 4.0
classification: Research plants, not a factory. Whole-plant panels at 65 DAP; C denotes control, L and T have different intervention histories. Rightmost 93-DAP flower closeup is not a second whole-plant time point.
observation: Control panel shows a tall central axis with lateral foliage and substantial floral structures. Lower junctions remain partly occluded. Our vegetative model omits the floral structures entirely.
